name: stubbedev/ds-mcp
description: DataStore MCP — one MCP server for MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, SQL Server, ClickHouse, MongoDB, Redis/Valkey, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and Qdrant (Rust, distributed as a prebuilt binary)

suggest.ext-curl: Downloads the binary; without it allow_url_fopen + openssl are used
suggest.ext-pcntl: Lets vendor/bin/ds-mcp exec the binary in place instead of running it as a child
suggest.ext-zip: Needed on Windows to unpack the release archive
